text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear planning. First, make a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and important work first, and do not waste time on low-value activities. Scope management matters too, because trying to do too much can cause delays. Be realistic about what you can finish and agree on limits early. Finally, communicate openly. If a problem appears, tell your team or manager immediately instead of waiting until the deadline. Good communication builds trust and helps everyone find solutions together.
